headlines: DRIVER CHARGED WITH DUI AFTER VAN HITS MIAMI-DADE SHERIFF CRUISER
VAN REAR-ENDS DEPUTY BEFORE SUSPECT TOSSES BOTTLE
MIAMI-DADE DEPUTY STRUCK FROM BEHIND IN SHOCKING DUI TRAFFIC STOP
posts.article: A 72-year-old driver faces a DUI charge in Miami-Dade after colliding directly with local law enforcement. Dashcam video captured the incident as the man's van rolled into the back of a stopped Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office cruiser. The impact triggered an immediate traffic stop on the roadway. Witnesses reported that the elderly driver then attempted to get rid of evidence. While interacting with law enforcement, he tried to toss a bottle away during the encounter. Following the collision and the witness reports, deputies formally charged the driver with DUI.
